researchNote: Five-chapter expansion at the same immutable source revision used by the existing atlas. Synthetic teaching fixtures are explicitly labelled and never presented as published vectors.

chapters.questionTitle: How does a PSBT learn to sign Taproot and MuSig2?
misconceptionChecklist: PSBTv2 is not PSBTv1; the next version after v0 is v2
Taproot and MuSig2 fields extend both PSBT versions
Parsing a record does not establish that signing is safe
requiredTestFamilies: Published valid and invalid PSBTv2 globals
MuSig2 participant, nonce and partial-signature vectors

chapters.questionTitle: How can a block arrive without every transaction?
misconceptionChecklist: A short ID is not a cryptographic transaction identifier
A missing transaction needs a round trip, not a guessed replacement
Collisions fall back rather than banning a peer
requiredTestFamilies: Missing, mismatched and colliding reconstruction scenarios

chapters.questionTitle: When can an unconfirmed transaction be replaced?
misconceptionChecklist: Opt-in signaling is not a promise of replacement
Higher fee rate alone does not satisfy every rule
Mempool policy is not consensus or confirmation

chapters.questionTitle: How does a link become a payment instruction?
misconceptionChecklist: An empty address body still needs a payment instruction
A callback is not permission to open a web URL
requiredTestFamilies: Every published valid and invalid URI

chapters.questionTitle: How do nodes share addresses that do not fit in 16 bytes?
misconceptionChecklist: Variable address length does not mean arbitrary length
Tor v2 is deprecated and must not be relayed
A decodable endpoint is not proof of reachability
requiredTestFamilies: Every network length and round trip

supportingNote: BIPs 141, 143, 144, 174, 327 and 352 provide transaction, PSBT, signing and payment-instruction context. Their full chapters live elsewhere in the atlas.
